text:
Josh (Finance): Heads-up — customer ACME has flagged a big jump in their private cluster bill in eu-west last month. They say licensing + cloud charges doubled vs estimate. Can infra confirm what landed on that invoice?
Alex E.: Looking now. Which invoice id or deployment?
Josh (Finance): invoice# INV-2026-ACME-09 linked in workspace. Private VPC deployment, 8 dedicated A100s + onprem license pass-through.
Maria Ops: I see a spike around 2026-09-14 — large sustained allocation from eu-west-1a. Possibly an unexpected autoscale event.
Ravi (Infra): We had a scheduled test of burst capacity for Dedicated customers on 9/14 to validate failover. That added ~48 GPU-hours billed to that account before we rolled back.
Tina - Sales: Oof — ACME contract had a capped monthly pass-through estimate in SOW. Did we notify them before the failover?
Josh (Finance): They say no notification, and their PO won't cover the extra. Need options: credit, re-bill, or absorption.
Alex E.: Two parts: cloud usage (GPU-hours + egress) and our license amortization. For cloud we can check if committed discounts (CUD/Savings Plan) should've covered it. For license, we passed full license line-item as agreed.
Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-ACME-09: https://billing.example.com/invoices/INV-2026-ACME-09 (shows extra: 48 GPU-hours, 0.7TB egress)
Josh (Finance): Can infra confirm whether those 48 GPU-hours were covered by our reserved commitments in eu-west? If not, that explains the delta.
Ravi (Infra): Quick check: committed pool for eu-west had 500 reserved GPU-hours for September. We exhausted the pool on 9/12 due to another customer ramp. So the additional 48 were on-demand and full-price.
Maria Ops: Need to verify tagging alignment. If ACME VPC didn't carry the cost-center tag, usage might have been billed to us then backcharged incorrectly. We should confirm the billing account mapping.
Alex E.: Action items I propose: 1) Confirm reserved quota vs usage per account (show query) 2) Check billing export for tag mapping 3) Liaise with Sales/Legal about contract cap 4) Prepare adjustment proposal.
Josh (Finance): Agreed. For 1) Ravi/Infra can you run GCP query or AWS equivalent? Example:
```
# BigQuery export query (GCP Billing Export)
SELECT project.id, sku.description, usage_start_time, cost FROM `billing.gcp_billing_export`
WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-2026-ACME-09' AND sku.description LIKE '%GPU%';
```
Ravi (Infra): Running now. Also checking our internal reserved pool allocation ledger at /infra/commitments/september.csv
DevOps Bot: Reservation ledger snapshot: reservations/september/eu-west.csv attached.
Alex E.: Also check if autoscale policy allowed cross-tenant bursting into shared reserved pool. Our intended behavior: dedicated pools should not be drained by tests. But the failover test may have hit shared capacity.
Kavita (Legal): If contract includes a monthly cap for pass-through, we need to honor it or rely on change-order. Send me the SOW excerpt.
Tina - Sales: I have the SOW clause: "Customer billed for metered usage up to estimated monthly cap; overages subject to both parties' written approval." That leans toward offering a credit.
Josh (Finance): Let's quantify cost delta and propose options: full credit, partial credit + future discounted commitment, or invoice adjustment and move overage to our internal ops cost. Which is least precedent-setting?
Maria Ops: Partial credit + ask ACME to move to a small reserved commitment to cover base. Offer 3-month discounted add-on to lock their base.
Alex E.: Technical fix: restrict test/burst to isolated staging pools, and enforce tenant tags so billing export attribution is atomic. Also proactively buy regional short-term commitments to cover known tests.
Ravi (Infra): Query results: the 48 GPU-hours = $9,600 on-demand; reserved coverage would have been $2,400 (we had discounts). So delta ~$7,200 plus egress ~$120.
Josh (Finance): Noted. Drafting refund options: (A) Refund full $7,320 (hit P&L), (B) Refund $3,600 (50%) + offer 3mo reserved credits, (C) No refund but credit next invoice. Which recs?
Tina - Sales: ACME will push back if no refund. Recommend B. Keeps relationship without too much cost.
Kavita (Legal): B seems fair and contract-consistent if we include a change-order for future commitments.
Josh (Finance): I'll prepare a memo for exec sign-off recommending B and an internal root-cause ticket.
Alex E.: Infra action items: update autoscale policy, add pre-test reservation buys for planned tests, and implement billing-tag enforcement for private clusters.
Ravi (Infra): I'll open infra ticket INFRA-4427 and set ETA 2026-10-02.
Maria Ops: Ops will generate a runbook for private deployment billing checks: checklist includes reserved-pool status, billing-tag verification, and notification to customer for planned bursts.
DevOps Bot: INFRA-4427 created: https://go.example.com/INFRA-4427
Josh (Finance): Thanks. I'll cc Tina and Kavita on the customer credit note draft.
Tina (Sales): I'll own the customer comms. Draft ready tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Josh (Finance): Final note — let's add a proactive monthly report for top-10 private customers showing reserved cover vs usage so we catch this earlier.
Alex E.: Good idea. I'll add a dashboard card in Redwood Console: "Private reserved coverage".
Josh (Finance): OK closing thread after actions assigned.
